content.text:
Bilbao Aeropuerto is the wettest of the four and Madrid, Retiro is the driest. I read the annual precipitation (column R, row "Año") from each station's table on AEMET's Valores normales page:

| Station | Annual precipitation (mm) |
|---|---|
| Bilbao Aeropuerto | 1134 |
| Sevilla Aeropuerto | 539 |
| València | 475 |
| Madrid, Retiro | 421 |

The difference between Bilbao and Madrid, Retiro is 1134 − 421 = 713 mm.

ANSWER: Bilbao Aeropuerto; Madrid, Retiro; 713 mm
